hero.title: Widening access to quality, inclusive education
hero.subtitle: Keeping children in school and creating stronger learning opportunities, especially for girls and students facing the greatest barriers.

challenge.heading: The Challenge
challenge.text: Conflict, displacement and poverty keep many children in South Sudan out of school or in classrooms without trained teachers, learning materials or safe facilities. Girls, children with disabilities and displaced children are most likely to miss out, and hunger at home pulls children away from learning.

programme.heading: The Programme
programme.intro: Creating pathways to learn, grow and succeed
programme.text1: EmpowerKids–South Sudan’s Education Programme works to expand access to quality education and create opportunities for children and young people to continue learning.
programme.text2: Our work includes scholarship pathways, teacher development, school infrastructure improvements, solar electrification, school supplies and community engagement.
programme.text3: We focus particularly on students and communities facing barriers to education, while working with schools, teachers, families, partners and education stakeholders to strengthen learning opportunities.

educationInAction.heading: Education in Action
educationInAction.intro: Practical support for students, teachers and schools

cards.title: Bridge2Rwanda Scholarship Pathway
cards.description: Creating pathways for high-performing South Sudanese students to pursue fully funded university education. Through the Bridge2Rwanda partnership, EKSS has supported scholarship placements for students who have demonstrated academic potential and are ready to continue their education.

cards.title: Teacher Training
cards.description: Supporting teachers to strengthen their knowledge and classroom practice. EKSS has supported teachers to participate in training at Arizona State University, helping build teaching capacity and strengthen student-centred learning approaches.

cards.title: School Solar Electrification
cards.description: Helping schools access reliable electricity so that learning can continue beyond daylight hours and schools can make better use of digital and educational resources. EKSS has supported solar electrification at Juba Girls Secondary School and Nimule Model Secondary School.

cards.title: School Supplies & Community Engagement
cards.description: Education requires more than classrooms. EKSS supports school-related activities and community engagement that help strengthen the wider environment around children's education.
